name: Volume Rendering in 3D Slicer
definition: Volume rendering (also known as volume ray casting) is a visualization technique for displaying image volumes as 3D objects directly - without requiring segmentation. This is accomplished by specifying color and opacity for each voxel, based on its image intensity.
summary: Volume Rendering in 3D Slicer visualizes 3D image volumes without segmentation, distinguished by its integration with the Slicer data model for synchronized color mapping and medical imaging presets.
